text:
michael: quick note: Go sampleapp loses x-request-id when http.Client retry/redirect happens. saw it while testing onboarding.

sara: that breaks joins in kibana. any logs?

michael: trimmed logs: 
2024-11-05T15:04:01Z sampleapp DEBUG outgoing host=svc.internal x-request-id=req-go-77
2024-11-05T15:04:01Z sampleapp INFO http.redirect status=302 x-request-id=-

taylor: hmm looks like the second request (redirect or retry) doesn't carry custom headers. many Go libs clone the Request and Header map sometimes isn't copied.

michael: repro: using net/http default client with a RetryTransport wrapper that follows 302 and retries once; headers set on initial req but not on follow-up.

sara: mitigation: seed request-id into context (context.WithValue) in middleware and have our otel-nethttp hook re-inject allowlisted headers on every outgoing attempt. do not copy Authorization.

taylor: agree. also update quickstart note about redirect handling and add an e2e that simulates 302 and asserts x-request-id preserved.

michael: opening issue and a small PR with Context-based reinjection + test. telemetry-bot: Created issue #4899: "Go sampleapp: x-request-id lost across redirect/retry; add context reinjection + e2e"

telemetry-bot: linked PR #4901 to issue.
